checkpoint.required_local_hash_rule: Before any model load, every checkpoint file must have a local SHA-256 record; every LFS payload must equal the source snapshot manifest's frozen lfs_sha256 and bytes. The resolved revision metadata and the four frozen small-file SHA-256 values must also match.

software.runtime_provenance_gate: The mutable vllm/vllm-omni:cosmos3 tag is not sufficient provenance. Before load, record the immutable container digest or a reproducible environment lock plus git HEADs for both source checkouts and installed package versions.

preferred.gpu_requirement: 4 idle ali-owned B200 GPUs in one pod

conditional_fallback.release_rule: A successful tensor-parallel-two model-load and free-memory record is required before any model request. A failed load or OOM is infrastructure evidence only and leaves all cells unreleased.

prompts.left: Put the Rubik's cube to the left of the bowl.
prompts.right: Put the Rubik's cube to the right of the bowl.

required_provenance: source-backed output layout and joint order
direct_interface.reporting: A direct-interface result is never pooled with derived control.

derived_control_curobo_ik.eligible_only_if: The released base response is documented as DROID 10D end-effector pose plus gripper action with complete layout, units, frame, normalization, and absolute-versus-delta semantics.
required_controller_provenance: CuRobo package version and source commit
joint order, limits, start state, and gripper mapping
IK solver seeds, tolerances, collision world, collision configuration, and deterministic settings
per-step raw 10D model action, derived 8D joint_pos action, solver status, and transform hashes
derived_control_curobo_ik.failure_policy: No rejected IK/collision/limit/stale-state action is sent to the simulator. Retain it in a controller-rejection ledger outside requested-placement denominators; do not replace it with zero success.
derived_control_curobo_ik.reporting: Report as a derived-control CuRobo IK intervention, never as native policy execution and never pooled with direct-interface results.

fixed_observation_gate.input_rule: All three requests use the byte-identical frozen image and robot-state arrays from the completed Cosmos Edge DROID diagnostic.
required_outcomes: LEFT repeat returned actions are bit-identical
LEFT repeat decoded futures are bit-identical
LEFT and RIGHT returned actions differ
LEFT and RIGHT decoded futures differ
server echoes the exact requested sampling seed
every response contains a decodable future and an action representation admitted by exactly one execution branch
fixed_observation_gate.prohibited_outcome: A video-only, latent-only, action-only, undocumented, or silently transformed response does not release behavioral inference.

evidence_paths.media_contract: For each valid cell, retain ACTUAL ROLLOUT viewport MP4 and IMAGINED FUTURE decoded MP4 adjacent with seed, relation, prompt, model-action hash, and executed-action hash.

claim_boundary.separation_rule: Cosmos3-Super base remains distinct from completed Cosmos3 Edge, pending Cosmos3 Nano, Cosmos-Reason2 diagnostic, every VLA, and every RoboTwin denominator.
